__broaden__.ወመሳትየ: መስተይ — and drinking vessels (ወ- + plural መሳትይ of መስተይ, accusative; from ሰትየ 'drink') (?) · drinks / drinking-vessels as the text uses it (ወመሳትየ መፂፃነ 'and drinks ...', ch. 29): plural of መስተይ, here the drinks themselves as well as the cups
__broaden__.ወታስተዐጽብ: አስተዐጸበ — and she reckons hard, finds difficult (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, ʾastä-stem; the same verb as ch. 22 ያስተዐጽብ 'he marvelled, was astonished'; sense unconfirmed) (?) · also 'she is astonished' (ወታስተዐጽብ ፈድፋደ 'and she was astonished exceedingly', ch. 25) · 'she wonders at' with an object (ወታስተዐጽብ ክብረ ቤተ መንግሥት 'and she wonders at the glory of the royal house', ch. 29); cf. ዕጹብ 'wonderful, astonishing'
